title: Hello, Name
prompt: Write a program that reads a name with input and prints Hello NAME. The autograder will provide the name as input. For example, when the name is Ada, the output should be: Hello Ada.
learning_objective: Prompt for a name with input() and print a greeting that includes that name.
hint: Store the result of input() in a variable, then pass both 'Hello' and that variable to print().

student.py.starter:
name = input('Enter your name: ')
# Print the greeting
student.py.solution:
name = input('Enter your name: ')
print('Hello', name)

HelloNameTests.test_chuck.title: Greets Chuck
HelloNameTests.test_chuck.feedback: Read the name and include it in the printed greeting.
hints: The expected output is: Hello Chuck

HelloNameTests.test_ada.title: Works with another name
HelloNameTests.test_ada.feedback: Do not hard-code the example name.

solution_explanation: The program reads one string and passes it to print with the greeting.
